context: Riku-teen helps Sho-young learn to swim properly at the river.
purpose: Older teen patiently teaching younger one outdoor skill.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Soft, patient instruction. Steady breathing. Hand extended or gesturing. Speaking to reassure, not to perform. The ease of someone who has done this before.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: High, sharp edge on the opening. Breath catching. Genuine panic underneath, but trust in the voice too. Searching for reassurance, not performing distress.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Quieter now. Close to him, not shouting. Warm conviction without pressure. The tone of someone who knows fear and knows it passes.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Pure wonder, climbing upward. Breathless at the realization. Real delight, not performed. The voice of discovery — small and genuine and amazed.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.en: You did it. That's the practice right there.
lines.style: Warm, understated pride. A slight smile in the voice. Not overstating it — just reflecting back what happened. The confidence of someone steady.
